  • Roaming Print / Device Permission Control

Roaming Print / Device Permission Control

4.1 Set up a virtual printer for roaming print (shared); End Users only need to install a single printer.

4.2 Enable control queue printing; print jobs through this printer will be temporarily stored on the server, waiting for the user to authenticate and retrieve at any device.

4.3 Set physical printer; device mapping to physical device.

Control queue printing needs to be disabled.
